properties.name: The markdown readout no longer prints "Modularity 1.00 across 44 component(s)" over an unmodelled decomposition. When there is no partition it says NOT MEASURABLE, gives the ratio of components carrying any coupling, and states plainly that this is a fact about how much is modelled rather than a poor result. Measured on reflow2's own design: 182 allocated capabilities, 47 components, ONE capability-to-capability dependency — old readout 1.00, new readout not measurable.
